earnings.title: Contact: Investor Relations
highlights: Third quarter 2026 revenue of $3.05 billion increased 22%, compared with $2.51 billion in the third quarter of 2025.

Third quarter 2026 GAAP net income attributable to Intuitive Surgical, Inc. was $523 million, or $1.49 per diluted share, compared with $704 million, or $1.95 per diluted share, in the third quarter of 2025.

Third quarter 2026 GAAP net income attributable to Intuitive Surgical, Inc. included a pre-tax charge of $450 million in connection with the settlement of previously disclosed antitrust class action litigation.

Third quarter 2026 non-GAAP* net income attributable to Intuitive Surgical, Inc. was $1.05 billion, or $3.00 per diluted share, compared with $867 million, or $2.40 per diluted share, in the third quarter of 2025.

Third quarter 2026 GAAP and non-GAAP* net income attributable to Intuitive Surgical, Inc. included a benefit of $22 million, net of tax, or $0.06 per diluted share, related to refunds for tariffs paid in prior periods under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (“IEEPA”).

quotes.text: Our strong performance this quarter was marked by broad-based adoption across our multi-port, single-port, and Ion platforms, with customers using our systems to perform, on average, over 10,000 procedures per day throughout the period.
